title: Nightfall oncall docket — midnight->08:00 shift notes
content:
Shift window: 2028-08-11 00:00 -> 2028-08-11 08:00 PT
Owners: Aisha Patel (primary), Miguel Ortega (backup, 02:30-06:00)

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Quiet first 90 minutes. Around 01:45 we saw a small spike in token latency (p50->p95) for hosted-api-us-west, correlated with a rollout to a new kernel bundle on dedicated pool 3. Automatic fallback kicked in and routing stabilized traffic by 01:57. No customer-facing errors.
- A separate alert at 04:12 (PROD) for high CPU on a model-serving replica in eu-west (private customer). We scaled a pool and replaced the node; root cause likely a bad quantized checkpoint that increased memory thrashing — engineering investigating.
- Ongoing: cache shard eviction churn on redis-prefix-cache-4 causing brief increase in recompute time for long prompt sessions. Lowered cache TTL as a temporary mitigation (see Runbook Deltas).

Incidents and timeline:
- 01:42-02:00 — Token latency surge (hosted-api-us-west)
  * Alert: tokens.latency.p95 > 800ms (alert threshold 700ms)
  * Root cause (suspected): rollout of kernel-bundle v7.4.2 to dedicated pool-3. Telemetry shows increased GPU kernel launch variance.
  * Actions taken: Automated routing fallback to kernel-bundle v7.4.1 (safe fallback) at 01:48; traffic throttling for canary route until 02:00; engineers paged but not escalated.
  * Outcome: p95 returned to baseline by 01:57. Logged as P2 for follow-up.

- 04:12-05:10 — High CPU on model-replica-24 (eu-west-private customer)
  * Alert: host.cpu.util > 92% for > 5m, process oom-swap warnings
  * Immediate mitigation: cordon + replace node (miguel executed replacement 04:25), moved traffic to warm spare pool.
  * Investigation notes: model binary loaded with new quantized checkpoint id qc-2028-07-29. Heap profiler indicates increased kernel launch memory overhead. Customer reported intermittent slow generations after 03:45.
  * Action items: engineering to reproduce with qc-2028-07-29 on staging; possible rollback if confirmed. Jira INC-4239 opened.

- 06:20 — Cache eviction churn (redis-prefix-cache-4)
  * Symptoms: increased backend recompute for long-session prompts, slight uptick in token cost and latency for prompt lengths > 2k tokens.
  * Temporary fix: reduced max entries and TTL to reduce eviction noise (10min -> 2min) and enabled debug logging for prefix-cache.
  * Follow-up: run stress test 2028-08-12 10:00 PT to measure TTL impact on token throughput and QPS.

Runbook deltas / suggested edits (quick patches to the living runbook):
- Serving Runtime -> Kernel Rollouts section: add explicit pre-rollout p95 metric check on dedicated pools and auto-fallback threshold (suggested: if kernel rollout increases p95 by > 15% for > 3m, pause rollout and auto-fallback).
- Private Deployments -> Model Checkpoint validation: add a lightweight memory/heap smoke test that runs quantized checkpoint through a synthetic inference loop (configurable tokens and batch size) before allowing prod traffic.
- Cache runbook: add emergency TTL knob and exact steps for toggling debug logs and restoring metrics. Include rollback play for TTL changes if token cost jumps > 10%.

Metrics snapshot (during peak windows):
- hosted-api-us-west p95 tokens latency: baseline ~280ms -> spike 842ms -> rollback -> 290ms
- gpu-pod kernel launch variance (stdev ms): baseline 11ms -> spike 47ms during canary
- eu-west host.cpu.util for replica-24: peaked 98% before replacement, avg 18% after warm spare move
- redis-prefix-cache-4 evictions/min: baseline 12 -> spike 430 during churn

Open follow-ups (owners & deadlines):
- ENG: Reproduce qc-2028-07-29 behavior in staging and decide rollback by 2028-08-13 EOD (owner: @samantha.li, Jira: INC-4239).
- SRE: Draft kernel-rollout auto-fallback proposal and send to runtime-arch for review by 2028-08-14 (owner: @aisha.patel).
- Observability: Add a composite dashboard for kernel rollout health (p50/p95, kernel launch variance, GPU occupancy) by 2028-08-18 (owner: @miguel.ortega).
- Ops: Run the cache TTL stress test 2028-08-12 10:00 PT and post results in #sre-ops (owner: @ops-team).

Handoff checklist for next shift (08:00-16:00):
- Check INC-4239 reproduction status and any staging logs.
- Watch hosted-api-us-west p95 for 2 hours after our rollback; ensure no regression if rollout resumes.
- Validate redis-prefix-cache-4 eviction rate after TTL change; revert to 10min if test shows token-cost >10% increase.
- Confirm replacement node details and keep node snapshot (QA: vm-image, kernel-bundles installed).

Notes to next shift (informal):
- If you see a kernel rollout in dedicated pool-3, prefer immediate fallback to 7.4.1 and open the canary channel for runtime-arch. Avoid mass rollback without coordination.
- The private-customer replica shows patterns consistent with quantization memory anomalies — not a cluster-wide GPU issue. Keep replacement as first action.
- Cache TTL change is a blunt instrument — expect short-term cost increase; we chose it because it reduced jitter quickly.

Quick commands & pointers (copy-paste):
- Check p95 times: curl -sS "https://observability/api/metrics?query=tokens.latency.p95&env=hosted-api-us-west" | jq
- Force fallback for pool-3: ./opsctl rollout fallback --pool pool-3 --bundle kernel-bundle-v7.4.1 --reason "p95 spike 2028-08-11"
- Replace node: ./infractl node replace --node model-replica-24 --preserve-logs --snapshot

Raw logs / links referenced:
- Alerts: https://alerts.redwood-internal/graph/INC-4239
- Canary traces (01:40-02:05): https://tracing.redwood-internal/trace/7f2a1c
- Cache metrics panel: https://dashboards.redwood-internal/d/redis-prefix-cache-4

Unresolved questions:
- Is qc-2028-07-29 a mutated build from the quantization pipeline, or did packaging alter memory alignment? Needs build-ops signoff.
- Should we add a pre-rollout staging smoke test for kernel bundles similar to model checkpoints? (raised to runtime-arch)

Sign-off: Aisha Patel (onsite), Miguel Ortega (remote, midnight->06:00).

If anything critical pops up ping me directly (pager: aisha.pager) or escalate to @eng-oncall-senior.

End of docket.
